# Yicheng Jiang

> Personal academic homepage for Yicheng Jiang (蒋益诚), a Ph.D. student in Electronic and Computer Engineering at the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST). Research focuses on embodied AI, robotic learning, 3D/4D visual representation, world models, and robotic manipulation.

## Canonical source

- [Homepage](https://ethenj.com/): canonical profile, research overview, selected publications, projects, experience, and awards.

## Profile and research

- [About and research interests](https://ethenj.com/#about): current Ph.D. study at HKUST, supervised by Prof. Qiming Shao; research interests and background.
- [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=WudbxWkAAAAJ): complete scholarly publication profile.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/EthenJ): software and open-source work.

## Selected publications

- [Learning Structural Latent Points for Efficient Visual Representations in Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21258) — ICRA 2026.
- [MVISTA-4D: View-Consistent 4D World Model with Test-Time Action Inference for Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.09878) — ICML 2026.
- [In-Memory Neural Stochastic Differential Equations with Probabilistic Differential Pair Achieved by In-Situ P-Bit](https://doi.org/10.1109/IEDM50854.2024.10873318) — IEDM 2024.
- [All selected-publication details](https://ethenj.com/#publications): author lists, venues, years, and paper or DOI links.
